column3: “The iron” is rendered “the axe head,” and “it was asked” as “it was borrowed.”
“A piece of wood” is rendered “a stick.”
“A place of a certain one, a certain one” is rendered “such and such a place.”
“Not once and not twice” is rendered “more than once or twice.”
“Who of those who are ours” is rendered “which of us.”
“Chamber of your lying down” is rendered “bedroom.”
NASB supplies “was sold” and “shekels.” “Dove’s dung” translates an uncertain Hebrew word.
“What is to you?” is rendered “What is the matter with you?”
NASB sets “he was passing by on the wall” in dashes.
